title: Check: Development of the Atomic Model

questions.stem: Which scientist proposed the 'plum pudding' model of the atom?
questions.explanation: J.J. Thomson proposed the plum pudding model in 1897 after discovering the electron. In this model, electrons were embedded in a sphere of positive charge, like plums in a pudding.

questions.stem: In Rutherford's gold foil experiment, most alpha particles passed straight through the foil. What did this show?

options.text: That gold atoms are very soft
That atoms are mostly empty space
That alpha particles have no charge
That electrons fill most of the atom

questions.explanation: The fact that most alpha particles passed straight through the gold foil without being deflected showed that the atom is mostly empty space. Only a very few particles bounced back, indicating that the nucleus is small and dense.
